$comment: The shared redaction corpus. Every QueueBox client library runs it, and so does QueueBox.
Section 8 of the work order says that no library prints a secret. A library that redacts
ALMOST the same as the others is a security defect, not a difference of idiom, so the cases
live here rather than in one language's test file.
The cases come from ErrorSanitizerTest and CredentialMaskingTest in core.
A case states the input and one of two expectations.
expected        the exact output. This pins the behaviour hardest, so prefer it.
mustNotContain  text that must not survive. Use it when the exact output is not the point.
mustContain     text that must survive, so an operator keeps the meaning of the message.
